entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Turpan water system, also called the Turfan kārēz system, is used for water supply via a vertical tunnel in the Turpan Depression of Xinjiang, China. "Karez" is a word in the local Uyghur language that is derived from the word in the Persian language for the system from which it is derived: kārīz. Turpan has the Turpan Karez Paradise, which is dedicated to demonstrating its karez water system, as well as exhibiting other historical artifacts.
